task:
SpecifierSet treats equivalent specifiers as distinct when they are spelled differently.

Specifier(">1.0.0") == Specifier(">1.0") is True, because trailing zeros do not matter. Yet SpecifierSet(">1.0.0,>1.0") != SpecifierSet(">1.0"). Their hashes and their strings differ too. Both sets describe the same versions.

With a = SpecifierSet(">1.0.0,>1.0") and b = SpecifierSet(">1.0"), all of these must hold:
- a == b
- hash(a) == hash(b)
- str(a) == str(b), so str(a) is ">1.0"

The result must not depend on the order in which the two spellings were written. SpecifierSet(">1.0,>1.0.0") must give the same equality, hash and string as a.

Combining sets must still drop duplicates. str(SpecifierSet(">=1.0") & SpecifierSet(">=1.0,<5.0")) must be "<5.0,>=1.0".

Everything else must keep working, including the sorted order of str() and the prerelease rules of &.
